projectState.summary: Song Library slice is implemented on codex/byte-song-library-a and now addresses Arne's loop-fatigue feedback more directly. New song opens a starter modal with prompt, optional setup overrides, and player plans; Generate starter is required and visibly shows the validated setup, chosen hidden template, structure summary, material seed, and generated player briefs. Starter metadata persists on the library song. New src/song-starter-material.ts derives a deterministic 16-beat active SongMaterial phrase pack for pulse, bass, and written melody from the starter goal/materialSeed/player plans. Transport consumes this through TransportHandlers.songMaterial, and song sketch/form/melody scoring now inspect the same active material the listener hears. Default untitled songs still fall back to the old canned materials. Player plan checkboxes are still not a runtime roster system; they only influence/generated silence in the starter phrase pack for now. Validation: npm run build, focused song-library smoke, npm run smoke (78/78), npm run db:smoke, git diff --check all green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories.
